answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 42244 Country: India Title: Whenever I urinate and cleaned myself by pouring water, the moment I stepped out, two three drops of urine come out immediately Question: Whenever I urinate and cleaned myself by pouring water, the moment I stepped out, two three drops of urine come out immediately and I become napak along with the clothes. What should I do to get rid of this problem and to get paki always so that I can perform salah on time. Is there any dua which I can recite? Or if there is any other solution please let me know at the earliest I am in stress. Answer ID: 42244 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1677/1677/M=1433) Istibra is necessary after urination; istbra is to dry the drops with tissue papers or clay etc and then to wash the private part with water in case one has drops after urination. If the drop touched the body or clothes then it is enough to wash only that particular part. It is better for you to be free from istinja etc one hour before salah so that you could offer salah in time. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
